title: AnyGoal: On World Model Generalization Beyond Expert Rollouts
abstract: arXiv:2610.26844v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The goal of a world model is to capture the dynamics of an environment. This has the great appeal that it allows agents to plan and simulate a course of actions with the help of a world model. For these uses to be reliable, however, the learned dynamics must behave well beyond the specific state-action combinations observed in expert rollouts. Despite this, the relationship between data coverage, dynamics generalization, and downstream planning performance remains underexplored. We study this relationship through the lens of compositional generalization: can a world model recombine familiar state and action factors into valid dynamics? To answer this, we introduce AnyGoal, a benchmark of goal-shifted task variants built from widely used world-model environments, together with an open-source library. Each task is designed to be within reach of a world model that has learned the underlying dynamics: individual state factors and actions

translated_title: AnyGoal：超越专家轨迹的世界模型泛化研究
translated_abstract: 世界模型的目标是捕捉环境的动力学特性，其巨大吸引力在于使智能体能够借助世界模型来规划和模拟一系列动作。然而，要使这些用途可靠，所学到的动力学必须不仅在专家轨迹中所观察到的特定状态-动作组合内表现良好，还需在组合之外同样有效。尽管如此，数据覆盖范围、动力学泛化与下游规划性能之间的关系仍未得到充分探索。我们通过组合泛化的视角来研究这一关系：世界模型能否将熟悉的状态和动作因素重新组合成有效的动力学？为了回答这个问题，我们提出了AnyGoal，这是一个基于广泛使用的世界模型环境构建的目标偏移任务变体基准，并附带了开源库。每个任务都被设计为对于已学习到底层动力学的世界模型而言是可达的：单个状态因素和动作……
tldr: 该论文提出AnyGoal基准，通过目标偏移任务变体从组合泛化的视角研究世界模型能否将熟悉的状态与动作因素重组为专家轨迹之外的有效动力学，并揭示数据覆盖、动力学泛化与下游规划性能之间的关系。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces AnyGoal, a benchmark of goal-shifted task variants built from widely used world-model environments, to study through the lens of compositional generalization whether world models can recombine familiar state and action factors into valid dynamics beyond expert rollouts, and to illuminate the relationship between data coverage, dynamics generalization, and downstream planning performance.
